title: Government-convened meeting with university graduates in Malabo, criticized by CPDS
reason: Available records do not establish a protest by meeting attendees or a public protest demand; the government employment-information meeting and CPDS’s reported demand for the prime minister’s resignation must be treated as separate actions unless further evidence connects them.
notes: Retained as an unresolved exclusion/lead, not a finding that no protest occurred. Search results report more than 1,000 attendees at a government-convened meeting; attendees’ actions and event date remain unverified from a current body read. Europa Press body access failed at the tool cache; AhoraEG body attempts failed at DNS and tool cache. See receipts/manual notes R-S001-001, R-S001-002, R-S012-001 and R-S012-002. The January dossier’s cross-month EQG202101-X006 is based on a selective read of this exact Europa Press URL and describes an official information meeting; it does not establish a February protest.

title: Historical UNGE student scholarship protest and organizing reports (2014)
reason: The relevant search results identify historical 2014 student scholarship mobilization and related organizing; no February 2021 onset or continuity is evidenced.
notes: Search-result text displays dates in March, July and November 2014 for several items and relative-age indicators for S016/S017. Results report demonstrations, scholarship demands, a claimed crowd size and alleged detentions/gas, but all cards remain search_only and those details are unverified from article bodies. This exclusion retains false-positive leads and does not validate the historical claims.

title: Historical UNGE scholarship protests and related planned/cancelled actions (2015)
reason: Search-result publication dates place these student scholarship disputes and planned or cancelled actions in March–May 2015, outside February 2021; no later continuity is shown.
notes: These search-only pages concern student grievances, a planned meeting/letter, threatened protests or a cancelled PDGE rally. They are preserved to distinguish historical mobilization from a 2021 candidate; body scope and outcome details have not been verified.

title: Youth demonstration over the Rebola cultural center and director in August 2015
reason: The search-result text dates the reported Rebola event to August 2015, outside February 2021.
notes: The search result reports the date and describes a demonstration tied to a local cultural-center dispute with alleged security-force response. The page body was not directly opened; date and details remain discovery evidence, not February event coding.

title: PDGE-aligned demonstration outside the French Embassy in Malabo (2017)
reason: The source result places the event in June 2017, outside the unit; it also describes ruling-party support for a vice president directed at French legal proceedings.
notes: The displayed publication date is June 20, 2017; the search excerpt uses “yesterday” for the event date, which is not normalized here. Search-only; not a February 2021 protest.

title: UNGE Council scholarship protest threat with an undetermined historical year
reason: The search output marks the article as about 9.4 years old in October 2026 and describes a conditional threat to demonstrate after a May scholarship deadline; it is not evidence of an executed February 2021 gathering.
notes: Exact publication/event year is unresolved, so no date is assigned. Retained as a historical search-only lead rather than a no-event finding.
